I told Dana it's **Dock 38**, replying to her message in our direct message. I took it from her own message there on 14 Oct, where she said that's her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on.

I couldn't get it from the private note I saved for her in gbrain. Its recall feature refused to read anything because this shared bot's connection isn't linked to any one member. To fix that, whoever runs the gbrain server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. Since the bot works for several people, the other way is to list who it may act for with `--may-act-for` and name the member on each request.
